## What

Land the new workspace crate `pkix-zlint-bridge` with the public type surface — no subprocess invocation logic yet. Body methods are stubbed; the type shape, Send+Sync invariants, and serde feature gate are pinned so subsequent child beads (PKIX-jy95.7.2 / .7.3 / .7.4) can implement runtime logic without contesting the public API.

## Surface

In `pkix-zlint-bridge/src/lib.rs`:

- `Verdict` enum: `NotApplicable` / `Pass` / `Notice` / `Warn` / `Error` / `Fatal`. `#[non_exhaustive]`. Mirrors zlint `v3/lint/result.go` `LintStatus` ordering (pass < notice < warn < error < fatal).
- `ZlintLintInfo` struct: `check_id`, `description`, `citation`, `source`, `severity: pkix_lint::Severity`. Catalog metadata for one zlint check.
- `BridgeError` enum: 6 variants per PKIX-jy95.4 (`BinaryNotFound`, `BinaryNotExecutable`, `SubprocessFailed`, `SubprocessKilled`, `SubprocessTimeout`, `OutputParseError`). `#[non_exhaustive]`. `impl Display + std::error::Error`.
- `PerCertError` enum: 3 variants per PKIX-jy95.4 (`MalformedDer`, `UnsupportedCertType`, `Other`). `#[non_exhaustive]`. `impl Display + std::error::Error`.
- `BridgeConfig` struct: `zlint_path: PathBuf`, `timeout: Duration`. `Default::default()` -> `zlint_path = "zlint"`, `timeout = 60s`.
- `ZlintBridge` struct: holds `BridgeConfig` (+ future cache). `pub fn new(BridgeConfig) -> Result<Self, BridgeError>` stub that accepts any config.

All result/error types `Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq + Send + Sync + non_exhaustive`. `Hash` where the type is naturally hashable. `serde` feature gate adds `Serialize + Deserialize` derives via `cfg_attr`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-zlint-bridge` crate scaffolded under workspace, version 0.0.0 (matches sibling-stub convention for not-yet-shipped substantive content)
- [ ] Workspace Cargo.toml updated: members list + workspace deps entry
- [ ] Public types: `Verdict`, `ZlintLintInfo`, `BridgeError`, `PerCertError`, `BridgeConfig`, `ZlintBridge` (stub `new`)
- [ ] `Display + std::error::Error` impls on `BridgeError` and `PerCertError`
- [ ] `From` impls where structurally obvious (e.g., `From<std::io::Error> for BridgeError` is left for .7.2/.7.3)
- [ ] `serde` cargo feature gates `Serialize / Deserialize` derives
- [ ] Send + Sync compile-time assertions on `Verdict`, `ZlintLintInfo`, `BridgeError`, `PerCertError`, `BridgeConfig`, `ZlintBridge` (the const-block pattern per PKIX-2l0v.2)
- [ ] Type-shape unit tests pin: ordering on `Verdict`, default `BridgeConfig`, Display non-empty on `BridgeError` / `PerCertError`
- [ ] Crate-level rustdoc explains: not policy, infrastructure; cites PKIX-jy95.6 + .1 + .2 + .3 + .4 design decisions
- [ ] `pkix-zlint-bridge/CHANGELOG.md` with Unreleased entry
- [ ] AGENTS.md crate-inventory entry updated from "Not yet shipped" to current state
- [ ] cargo build / clippy --all-features -D warnings / fmt --check / doc --no-deps clean

## Out of scope

- `enumerate_lints()` subprocess invocation — that is PKIX-jy95.7.2.
- `run_on_cert` / `run_on_certs` runtime — PKIX-jy95.7.3 / .7.4.
- Cache layer — folded into PKIX-jy95.7.3.
- Integration tests against the zlint binary — PKIX-jy95.7.2 / .7.3.

- PKIX-jy95.1 / .2 / .3 / .4 (decisions; closed)
